notes.title: 🚚🔥 Hotdog Truck Simulator Update! 🔥🚚
notes.content:
[p]Big news, food truckers! Now your NPC customers aren’t shy — they’re rating and reviewing your restaurant live in-game![/p][p]⭐ Serve perfect burgers and hot dogs to get rave reviews.
⭐ Burn something or keep it messy? Watch your ratings drop — those picky NPCs [i]will[/i] notice!
⭐ Keep your place spotless and your stock fresh to win over the crowd.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45622230/09b058dc2db366437d826bd61de35d646ca99384.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Their feedback affects your reputation and how busy your truck gets. Can you keep everyone happy and climb to the top?[/p][p]Get back to the grill and prove you’re the ultimate hotdog boss! 🌭👑[/p]

notes.title: 🔥 Fire in the Kitchen! | New Update Alert
notes.content:
[p]What's new:[/p][p]Gas cylinder system added — your stove needs fuel now![/p][p]Leaving food unattended can cause kitchen fires.[/p][p]Grab the fire extinguisher and put out the flames before everything (and everyone) panics.[/p][p]Fires don’t just look cool — they can actually disrupt your business. Customers will run, your hotdogs will burn, and your stand will smell like regret. 🧯🌭[/p][p]Cook smart. Stay sharp.

notes.title: 🔔 Development Update
notes.content:
We’re still hard at work getting everything ready for release, but in the meantime, we wanted to give you a sneak peek at some of the features we’ve recently added to the game. This update brings a big step forward in gameplay depth, world-building, and overall hotdog-slinging immersion.


💰 Money & Banking System

In addition to your wallet, you now have a bank account.
Use ATMs to manage your money during gameplay.


🏙 A More Lively City

Environmental details have been improved to make the world feel more alive.
We’ve added new NPC types to diversify the crowd around your stand.


🛠 New Stand & Truck

A brand-new Hotdog Stand is now available.
We’ve also added a full-size Hotdog Truck (not drivable, but definitely upgradable and stylish).


🌭 New Food Items

More recipes and ingredients have been added to expand your menu.


📱 Phone System

Your in-game smartphone is here!
View customer-style social media posts about your shop.
Use the camera app to take photos and view them in your personal gallery.


🔥 Gas Cylinder System

Stoves now require gas cylinders to operate.
Make sure to keep an eye on your fuel if you want to keep grilling!


🎵 Music & Radio

We’ve introduced a radio system so you can choose background music to set the vibe.


We’re getting closer to release every day, and we’re excited to show you more soon.
Thanks for following the development of our game – stay tuned for more behind-the-scenes updates!

💡 Don’t forget to wishlist us on Steam to stay in the loop!
[🔗 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3109560/Hotdog_Truck_Simulator/]Hotdog Truck Simulator[/url]]

— The Dev Team
